title: portfolio_assess
description: Output of llm.assess_portfolio — a rough read of the candidate's portfolio items, feeding the Profiler. This is advisory signal only; the human-calibrated candidate_preferences is produced by the Profiler, not here. Careers are the 10 canonical ids.

per_field.description: One entry per career the portfolio shows evidence for.

evidence_strength.description: 0-10 how strongly the portfolio demonstrates this field.

note.description: 1 sentence: what in the portfolio supports this.

detected_skills.description: Canonical skill ids the portfolio evidences.

overall_summary.description: 1-2 sentence overall read of where the portfolio is strongest.
